Upload the club's training-records workbook. We match each row to the tracker's flight records; the workbook's times become the official (billed / logbook) times, while tracker data and flight replays are always preserved. Nothing is written until you apply, and a whole import can be reverted.

This clears all staged edits. Rows are rebuilt from the workbook and re-matched (useful after adding aircraft or members). Already-applied rows are re-detected and left alone.

Data import is available to club managers only.
